baseline.representation: project canonical row-Q4 teacher + FP16 KV

larc.weight_representation: group-64 signed Q4 with FP16 scale per 64-weight sub-row group
larc.conversion: 80-step teacher-layer function prefit, then 200-step hard-projected group-64 QAT recovery at lr=1.5e-3
larc.kv: rank-16 latent Q2; one scalar FP16 min/scale pair per 3-token K group and per 3-token V group; shared Q4 K/V bases; FP16 inverse-Gram for K and V; worst-case FP16 residual tail counted

quality_execution_note: Weight quality is evaluated using dequantized values exactly corresponding to the stored group-64 Q4 codes; KV quality uses the grouped latent-Q2 simulation with quantized Q4 bases and both inverse-Gram corrections. This is representation-faithful quality simulation, not the packed native weight kernel and not measured process memory.
claim_boundary: This is controlled synthetic character-LM evidence. It supports >10x modeled tensor-memory versus the project's row-Q4 baseline across 64..8192 context while average five-seed quality is approximately equal to that weak row-Q4 baseline. It does not establish parity with Q4_K_M, a real pretrained LLM, measured RAM, or GPU VRAM.
